name: Geomap Field
description: Field type storing an address with geolocation, plus a map widget and map formatter.
project_description:
The Geomap Field module provides a new type of field Address containing several fields: 

 
 Address name 
 Street 
 Postal code 
 City 
 Country 
 Additionnal address information 
 Latitude 
 Longitude 
 
 The fields are displayed next to a map that will indicate precisely where the marker will be positioned with the address entered. 

 A button is also available, it allows the webmaster to locate his address on the map. The latitude and longitude fields will be retrieved automatically (by default). The user also has the possibility to override the latitude and longitude if he needs to enter precise coordinates.

 This solution is very useful if you need to display contents on a map, because you will already have the precise coordinates of your marker stored in database. Therefore you have a gain in terms of performance because you don't need to search for the coordinates when the page loads. 

 The module also provides a field formatter to display the field as a map on your site. 

 A simple module for a simple purpose to avoid the heavier modules. 

 Dependencies 
 
 Geolocation Provider 
 Map Provider 
 
 Installation & Usage 
 
 See Installing contributed modules . 
 Create a new field on your content type and select Geomap. 
 Modify the display form and choose your map provider (OSM) and your geolocation provider ( Nominatim, Bano ) 
 
 Requirements 
 No special requirements.

 Recommended modules 
 No specific recommendations, you can use this module as is.

 Roadmap 
 This module is minimally maintained. It will be updated if needed but no further development is planned.
